# capability

The `context.compact` mandate capability as plain data: an agent granted it may
compact its own context with `compact_context`. A leaf — `self-compact` imports
`conversations` (to type turns), and `conversations` reaches `mandate-presets`,
which grants it. The tool, describe text and delivery stay in `self-compact`.

## Plugin reference

- Description: The context.compact mandate capability as plain data. A leaf, so a mandate author (mandate-presets, reached from conversations) can grant it without a cycle through self-compact, which imports conversations.
